class.name: BBVariant
class.description: Variant-type parameter intended for use with [BehaviorTree] tasks. See [BBParam]. The data type is specified by [member type]. The type catalog follows the running engine: Struct is offered on Redot 26.3 and absent on 26.2. Selecting Struct constructs an empty value; define custom fields in 26.3 script. PackedVector4Array defaults to an empty array.

members.member: Specified [enum Variant.Type] for the parameter value.
